_comment: Second-pass job: split an already-separated INSTRUMENTAL into its parts.
Point audio_url at an instrumental stem a previous job produced (not the
full mix) — source_stem tells the handler to drop the near-silent vocal
output and reconcile `other` so the kept stems sum back to the input.
Swap model to 'demucs-ft' for best 4-stem quality without guitar/piano.
Run with: cp test_input_split.json test_input.json && python handler.py
